Location

Discover the charm of 2809 Sedgwick Avenue in Kingsbridge, a residential neighborhood in the northwest Bronx where convenience meets community. Enjoy easy access to local bus routes and nearby subway connections, along with neighborhood grocery stores, restaurants, and everyday shopping. Residents can also enjoy nearby green spaces, including the Jerome Park Reservoir, offering opportunities for recreation and outdoor activities. With a walkable neighborhood and convenient public transportation, this location offers a comfortable and connected Bronx lifestyle.
